plan.title: Fenced terminal transcript is not blocking acceptance; with-floor empty skip must not silently pass

narratives.Description: Residual for PR 3518: a transcript skip that leaves zero captured commands on a project with a suite floor must not silently empty-pass. Greptile fence-closer and whole-fence findings are false positives. Mixed-fence prompt skip is intended.
narratives.Overview: Product capture already skips output-shaped fences and prompt lines inside a transcript fence (#3511). Residual: if that skip leaves ZERO captured commands on a project WITH a suite floor, verify:ac must not silently empty-pass. #3334 soft_empty covers no-suite-floor. Do not weaken transcript detection. Do not change the safety allowlist. Fence closer length >= open.length is CommonMark and already correct. flushFenceBody has no whole-fence early return.
